exclusion_detail: The paper reports a single new compound, the glucuronide prodrug Glu-ALA-Hex, made in 7 steps (Scheme 1, section 2.2: 'synthesized in 7-steps') from D-glucuronolactone.

lead.label: Glu-ALA-Hex
lead.why: We have designed and synthesized a new prodrug of ALA-Hex ... The glucuronide prodrug Glu-ALA-Hex demonstrates excellent stability ... (abstract); it is the only final compound.

notes: Only one target compound in the paper; intermediates 1-3 etc. are not the lead.
